notes: Printed: 'Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may have this enchantment become a 3/3 Sphinx creature with flying in addition to its other types until end of turn.' Casting Short Sword (an artifact, so a noncreature spell) and answering 'fire' makes Riddleform a 3/3 flying creature this turn: it can be declared as an attacker (it has been under its controller's control since the turn began) and deals 3 to the opponent (20 -> 17).
